as_of: Sep 8, 2026 early US trading — Wall St mixed as oil nears $100 (US-Iran/Houthi strikes + Canada tariffs), Dow ~-446, Qualcomm +10% buoying chips, HSI slips lower, BTC slides under $78.5k

dow_jones.note: Dow ~52,968 (-0.84%), underperforming on oil-led, trade-war pressure in the first trading session after the Labor Day break. Crude's march toward $100 and Canada's $27.6B retaliatory tariffs (effective Tue) hit industrials/materials.

sp500.note: S&P 500 ~7,706 (-0.16%). Resilient vs Dow thanks to the tech/AI bid led by Qualcomm's data-center deal with Amazon; energy-led inflation and hawkish-Fed repricing cap upside. Fri close was 7,718.60.

nasdaq.note: Nasdaq ~26,500 (-0.03%), roughly flat. AI/chip strength (QCOM +9-10% on Amazon custom-chip warrant deal) offsets broader risk-off; 'model fatigue' worries persist in the AI complex.

us_markets.note: US cash markets re-opened Tuesday Sep 8 after the Mon Sep 7 Labor Day holiday. Early trade is MIXED: Dow led lower ~-0.8% on oil/near-$100 crude and Canada-US tariff escalation, while Nasdaq hugged flat on a Qualcomm-led chip rally. Investors watch the Fed and the US-Iran/Hormuz situation.

hang_seng.note: Hang Seng closed 25,317.18 (-0.38%) Tuesday, slipping ~95 pts as tech and insurers weighed while mining and oil names rallied on the crude spike. Rebound from Monday's deeper -0.93% loss.

hscei.note: Hang Seng China Enterprises tracking lower with tech; mainland insurers under pressure while energy/resources outperform on the oil bid.

hstech.note: Hang Seng TECH softened as tech/insurer names dragged; regional semis (Tokyo, Samsung) firmed on AI optimism but HK tech lagged the oil-led rotation.

hong_kong.note: HK closed lower Tuesday (HSI -0.38%) as tech and insurers lost ground, offset by a rally in oil and mining stocks tracking crude near $100. Overnight US futures weakness and renewed Middle-East supply risk set a cautious tone into the rest of the week.

btc.note: BTC ~$78,176 (-1.19% on the day) per Yahoo Finance — slid under $78,500 as oil-driven risk-off and a firm yen/dollar pressured crypto; BNB and some DeFi tokens bucked the selloff.

eth.note: ETH ~$2,461 (-1.19%). Stalling below $2,500; exchange reserves at fresh multi-year lows keep a medium-term bullish underpin, but momentum is thin with ADX low and macro risk high.

crypto.note: Crypto sliding Tuesday as U.S.-Iran fighting and crude near $100 sour risk appetite; BTC fell below ~$78.5k while ETH defends ~$2,450-2,500. Direction remains hostage to oil, the Fed, and Mideast headlines.

macro.oil_near_100: CRITICAL: Crude remains the dominant driver — oil hit multi-week highs after Houthi attacks on Saudi energy facilities, with Brent near $98-100 and WTI above $93. US-Iran strikes over the weekend + renewed Gulf supply risk keep the energy-led inflation and hawkish-Fed trade front and center.
macro.canada_tariffs_in_effect: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth C$27.6B took effect Tuesday, doubling duties on US steel/aluminum to 50% — a deepening Washington-Ottawa trade rift layered on top of the oil shock.
macro.yen_154: Yen holds firm near 153.8-154, a fresh cycle high, keeping traders alert for BOJ intervention. Sharp FX strength is a global-liquidity/FX-stress watch item.
macro.qualcomm_ai: Risk-on undercurrent: Qualcomm popped ~10% after signing a custom AI-chip/data-center deal with Amazon (incl. a 25M-share warrant). A bright spot for the AI trade amid 'model fatigue' chatter.
macro.fed_hike_watch: Blowout August payrolls (+162k vs ~110k est.) keep 'will the Fed hike again?' alive; hawkish pricing into the oil shock is a key cross-market headwind.
macro.europe_oil_drag: European shares slipped Tuesday as higher crude revived inflation worries, with Novartis (-9% on drug-trial setbacks) a notable drag; ECB rate path back in focus.
macro.september_watch: Focus: oil at ~$100 and whether US-Iran/Hormuz risk caps or eases; yen intervention risk; the Fed's path; Canada-US tariff escalation; and whether the AI/chip bid (Qualcomm-Amazon) holds against macro drag.

headlines.title: Oil hits multi-week highs after Houthi attacks on Saudi energy facilities
headlines.impact: Brent ~$98-100, WTI >$93; energy-inflation pressures equity multiples and keeps the hawkish-Fed trade alive. Top macro risk.

headlines.title: Brent crude nears $100 after strikes on Saudi energy sites amid renewed Mideast hostilities
headlines.impact: Gulf supply risk reinforced the crude bid; watch airline/consumer margins and inflation pass-through.

headlines.title: Dow futures edge lower as oil prices climb, Mideast tensions rise; S&P/Dow/Nasdaq 100 futures fall as oil tops $99
headlines.impact: US pre-open risk-off; Dow led lower in early cash trade though Nasdaq hugged flat on the chip bid.

headlines.title: Wall Street mixed in early trading while oil prices push higher yet again
headlines.impact: Dow -~0.8% vs Nasdaq ~flat: sector rotation as energy-led inflation hits value/cyclicals but tech resists.

headlines.title: Qualcomm stock pops 10% on data center infrastructure deal with Amazon (custom AI chips + 25M-share warrant)
headlines.impact: Bright spot for the AI trade; lifts semiconductor sentiment even as 'model fatigue' questions persist.

headlines.title: Hang Seng slips 95 points as tech, insurers weigh, mining and oil stocks rally
headlines.impact: HSI closed -0.38% at 25,317; oil/materials outperform as tech lags in HK.

headlines.title: European shares dip as higher crude revives inflation worries; Novartis drags
headlines.impact: Euro-area stocks slipped Tuesday; ECB rate path and surging crude sharpen the inflation debate.

headlines.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth $27.6B take effect as trade rift with US deepens
headlines.impact: Steel/aluminum duties doubled to 50%; fresh North-America trade friction alongside the oil shock.

headlines.title: Bitcoin slides to ~$78,800 as BNB and DeFi tokens buck the selloff
headlines.impact: Crypto risk-off on US-Iran fighting and crude; some altcoins diverge higher.
